infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cue shows your script over the camera so you can read and record at the same time. Videos stay on your phone.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cue records sound with your videos, and Voice Pace listens for when you are talking so the words wait for you. Nothing is uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Cue saves each take to your Photos. It can't see your other photos.
